title: La plata
desc: An argument about money that is not about money
setting: There is not enough this fortnight and you have both known it since Tuesday.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: No alcanza. Otra vez no alcanza.
steps.en: It is not enough. Again it is not enough.

options.es: Ya sé. Sentémonos a ver los números juntos.
options.en: I know. Let us sit down and look at the numbers together.
options.feedback: You agreed and made it a thing the two of you do. That takes the accusation out of the room before it forms.

options.en: Yes, it is a hard month.
options.feedback: True, and it agrees without doing anything. She was not reporting the weather.
A defence to something that was not a charge. That is how this becomes the other argument.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: Es que se nos fue en cosas que no eran.
steps.en: The thing is it went on things that were not necessary.

options.feedback: You asked her to drop the indirect. Between the two of you that is the right moment to ask for it.

options.en: All right, we have to be more careful.
options.feedback: Agreeing with the general is how the specific never gets said.

options.es: Ah, ya sé para dónde va esto.
options.en: Ah, I know where this is going.
options.feedback: You just told her that whatever she says next will not be heard.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: La bomba del carro. Eso podía esperar.
steps.en: The pump for the car. That could have waited.

options.es: Tenés razón. Eso lo compré sin preguntarte.
options.en: You are right. I bought that without asking you.
options.feedback: Conceded the point and named the real problem, which was the asking and not the money.
Arguing the price argues the wrong half. She said it could have waited.

options.es: Y las cosas de tu mamá qué.
options.en: And what about your mother's things.
options.feedback: Bringing the suegra into a money argument is lighting the second fire while the first one is going.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.en: I only want us to talk about it first.

options.es: De acuerdo. Nada de cien pesos para arriba sin decirnos.
options.en: Agreed. Nothing over a hundred without telling each other.
options.feedback: You turned it into a rule that applies to both of you. That is a fix instead of an apology.

options.en: All right, I will tell you.
options.feedback: Accepted. Only one of you is bound by it, which she will notice in a month.

options.en: You do not tell me everything either.
options.feedback: Perhaps true. Said now, it is only there to stop the sentence she was finishing.
